items.name: PBQ Utah Championship 2025
items.information:
This competition only has blindfolded and FMC and is not recommended for newcomers.

This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Club members are eligible for a discounted registration fee. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQUtahChampionship2025#59108-cubing-club-at-uvu).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

items.information:

### This is the 2nd annual Minnesota Championship! 

### This competition has no 3x3 and is not recommended for newcomers.
### Check out [Minnesota Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaChampionship2025) for a typical competition experience!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
